palette.notes: Frames: near-monochrome grey-blue background (sky, ruined city, gravestones) and a hero in steel blue, dusty purple and one strong red (sash, blood pool). The red is the only saturated colour on screen.

lighting: Flat diffuse overcast light on a pale misty ground, so the darker hero reads by value. Influences are Murillo, Goya, Ribera, Velazquez and Zurbaran (wiki), painters of dark grounds; here the ground is pale instead.
silhouette: The Penitent One: tall pointed capirote helmet wrapped in thorns, a face mask, cloak and a long sword held low in a wide stance (frames). Reads at any size; cosplay clips show the same shape is recognisable off-screen too.

motion.timing: No frame timings measured. Clip 1 is a near-still idle held for 12 s: breathing and cloth only, while a slow push-in grows the hero from small to large over ~5 s.

texture: Ornate, painterly: many small value steps on armour, rough dithered stone and mist in the background, sky with clustered clouds. Religious Seville iconography (wiki).
camera: Side view; the edit uses a slow zoom/push-in onto the idle hero and then holds still, letting the pose sit.
sound: Score by Carlos Viola; English voices, Spanish dub added later.

acting.enters: Starts small and far in the frame, grows as the camera pushes in (frames 0.5-5.7 s).
acting.acts: Silent knight holds a low guard stance and breathes; blood drips into a small red pool. Stillness is the acting.
acting.depth: Pale far city and gravestones in low contrast behind a dark, detailed hero in the foreground.

techniques: one iconic headpiece as the silhouette hook
low-contrast desaturated background, dark detailed hero
one saturated accent colour (red) on a near-grey screen
long subtle idle (breath, cloth) held instead of new actions
slow push-in to grow a still character
heavy, weighted animation on a silent hero
feel: grey misty ground + dark ornate hero + one red accent + long breathing idle = solemn, iconic
for_fred: Give Fred one beat of doing nothing: a held breathing idle (2 slow frames) while the camera pushes in from small to big, on a desaturated background with one red accent. Use it once as a pause between busy gags, not as filler.
